def: the clothes and styles that are popular at a time
example: She reads magazines about fashion.
note_ru: Не путайте с русским «фасон»: fashion — это мода в целом.

def: popular at this time
example: These boots are very fashionable this year.
example_ru: Эти сапоги очень модные в этом году.

def: a shoe that covers your foot and part of your leg
example: Put on your boots, it is snowing.
note_ru: В британском английском boot — это ещё и багажник машины (амер. trunk).

def: soft sports shoes
example: I wear trainers when I go to the gym.
example_ru: Я надеваю кроссовки, когда иду в спортзал.
note_ru: Британское слово; в американском английском — sneakers.

def: a warm piece of clothing for the top of your body
example: It is cold, take a jumper with you.
note_ru: Британское слово; американцы говорят sweater.

def: a long piece of cloth you wear around your neck
example: My grandmother made this scarf for me.
example_ru: Моя бабушка сделала этот шарф для меня.
note_ru: Множественное число — scarves.

def: a piece of clothing for your hand
example: I lost one of my gloves on the bus.
example_ru: Я потерял одну из перчаток в автобусе.

def: a long piece of leather or cloth you wear around your waist
example: These trousers are too big, I need a belt.
example_ru: Эти брюки слишком большие, мне нужен ремень.

def: a long thin piece of cloth that men wear around the neck with a shirt
example: He wears a shirt and tie to work.
example_ru: Он носит рубашку и галстук на работу.
note_ru: Глагол to tie — завязывать: tie your shoes.

def: soft clothes you wear in bed
example: The children are already in their pyjamas.
note_ru: Британское написание pyjamas, американское — pajamas. Слово всегда во множественном числе.

def: short trousers that stop above the knee
example: In summer I wear shorts and a T-shirt.
example_ru: Летом я ношу шорты и футболку.
note_ru: Всегда множественное число: a pair of shorts.

def: a small bag in your clothes for keeping things
example: My phone is in my pocket.

def: a small round thing on clothes that closes them; also a thing you press
example: A button on my shirt is missing.
example_ru: На моей рубашке не хватает пуговицы.
note_ru: Также кнопка на устройстве: press the button.

def: a soft natural material for clothes
example: This T-shirt is made of cotton.

def: the skin of an animal used for shoes, bags and jackets
example: He bought a black leather jacket.
note_ru: Кожа человека — skin, а материал для обуви и сумок — leather.

def: a piece of jewellery that you wear around your neck
example: She got a gold necklace for her birthday.
example_ru: Она получила золотое ожерелье на день рождения.

def: rings, necklaces and other beautiful things you wear
example: She never wears jewellery at work.
example_ru: Она никогда не носит украшения на работе.
note_ru: Неисчисляемое: a piece of jewellery. Американское написание — jewelry.

def: colours you put on your face to look nice
example: She puts on make-up every morning.

def: when someone cuts your hair; the style of your hair
example: You need a haircut, your hair is too long.
example_ru: Тебе нужна стрижка, у тебя слишком длинные волосы.
note_ru: Устойчивое выражение: to have / get a haircut — подстричься.

def: hair above a man's mouth
example: My dad has a big black moustache.
example_ru: У моего папы большие чёрные усы.
note_ru: Американское написание — mustache; в английском слово в единственном числе.

def: with no hair on the head
example: My uncle is bald, but he looks great.
example_ru: Мой дядя лысый, но он выглядит отлично.

def: nice to look at (usually about girls, women or things)
example: What a pretty dress!
note_ru: Pretty также наречие «довольно»: pretty good — довольно хорошо.

def: not nice to look at
example: I think this coat is ugly.

def: too small for your body; close to the skin
example: These jeans are too tight for me.
note_ru: Антоним — loose (свободный).

def: to put on nice or special clothes
example: We always dress up for New Year's Eve.
example_ru: Мы всегда наряжаемся в новогоднюю ночь.
note_ru: Также «переодеваться в костюм»: dress up as a pirate.

def: thick cloud near the ground that is difficult to see through
example: There was thick fog on the road this morning.
example_ru: Сегодня утром на дороге был густой туман.

def: with a lot of fog
example: It is foggy, so drive slowly.

def: the loud noise in the sky during a storm
example: The dog is afraid of thunder.
note_ru: Thunder — гром (звук), lightning — молния (свет).

def: a bright light in the sky during a storm
example: Lightning hit the old tree.
note_ru: Неисчисляемое: a flash of lightning. Не путайте с lighting (освещение).

def: what people say the weather will be like
example: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
example_ru: Прогноз говорит, что завтра будет дождь.
note_ru: Обычно weather forecast.

def: a light, pleasant wind
example: There was a cool breeze from the sea.
note_ru: Breeze — приятный лёгкий ветер; сильный ветер — strong wind.

def: to become ice; to be very cold
example: The lake freezes every winter.
note_ru: I'm freezing! — Я замерзаю!

def: to move air (about wind or with your mouth)
example: A cold wind is blowing from the north.

def: to give light
example: The sun is shining and the sky is blue.

def: covered with water; with rain
example: My shoes are wet because of the rain.

def: not wet; with no rain
example: It was a hot, dry summer.
note_ru: Также глагол to dry — сушить, высыхать.

def: not very cold and not very hot
example: Winters are mild in the south of England.

def: the light and heat from the sun
example: We sat in the sunshine and drank tea.
example_ru: Мы сидели на солнышке и пили чай.

def: a line of colours in the sky after rain
example: Look, there is a rainbow over the river!

def: a very big sea
example: The Atlantic Ocean is between Europe and America.
example_ru: Атлантический океан находится между Европой и Америкой.

def: one of the very big areas of land, like Africa or Asia
example: Africa is a very big continent.
note_ru: Британцы говорят the Continent о континентальной Европе.

def: the direction that is up on a map
example: Scotland is in the north of Britain.
note_ru: Прилагательное — northern (северный).

def: the direction that is down on a map
example: Birds fly south in winter.

def: the direction where the sun comes up
example: The sun rises in the east.

def: the direction where the sun goes down
example: Wales is in the west of Britain.

def: the most important city of a country
example: Paris is the capital of France.
note_ru: Также capital letter — заглавная буква.

def: a high steep rock, often next to the sea
example: Don't go near the cliff, it is dangerous.
example_ru: Не подходи к обрыву, это опасно.

def: the planet we live on; the ground
example: The Earth goes round the Sun.
note_ru: Планета — с большой буквы и артиклем: the Earth.

def: the surface of the earth that we walk on
example: The ground was wet after the rain.
note_ru: Земля под ногами — ground; земля как почва — soil; планета — Earth.

def: the usual weather in a place
example: Spain has a warm climate.

def: the thick white part of milk; a soft sweet food
example: Do you take cream in your coffee?
note_ru: Ice cream — мороженое; sour cream — сметана.

def: a small spoon for tea or coffee; also how much it holds
example: Add two teaspoons of sugar.
note_ru: Столовая ложка — tablespoon; в рецептах сокращают tsp и tbsp.

def: a hot powder for food; also a red, green or yellow vegetable
example: Add some salt and pepper.

def: a metal container for food that you open with a tin opener
example: Open a tin of tomatoes for the sauce.
note_ru: Британское слово; в американском английском — can.

def: a small white vegetable with a very strong taste
example: I love garlic in my pasta.
note_ru: Неисчисляемое: a clove of garlic — зубчик чеснока.

def: a white powder for making bread and cakes
example: We need flour, eggs and milk for the cake.
example_ru: Нам нужны мука, яйца и молоко для торта.
note_ru: Произносится так же, как flower (цветок).

def: a liquid from plants used for cooking
example: Fry the fish in a little oil.
example_ru: Пожарь рыбу в небольшом количестве масла.
note_ru: Сливочное масло — butter, растительное — oil.

def: a liquid that you put on food
example: Do you want tomato sauce with your chips?
example_ru: Хочешь томатный соус к картошке фри?

def: with a lot of salt
example: This soup is too salty.

def: with the taste of sugar
example: I don't like very sweet tea.
example_ru: Я не люблю очень сладкий чай.
note_ru: Sweets (брит.) — конфеты; амер. — candy.

def: made at home, not bought in a shop
example: My grandmother makes homemade bread every Sunday.
example_ru: Моя бабушка печёт домашний хлеб каждое воскресенье.

def: with a lot of juice
example: These oranges are big and juicy.

def: to take the skin off fruit or vegetables
example: Peel the potatoes and cut them.

def: to press something hard to get the juice out
example: Squeeze a lemon over the fish.
note_ru: Freshly squeezed juice — свежевыжатый сок.

def: to make something hot
example: Heat the soup for five minutes.
note_ru: Разогреть еду — heat up: heat up the pizza.

def: to give food or drink to people
example: Serve the fish with rice.

def: to put butter or jam on bread
example: Spread some butter on the bread.

def: to have a smell; to notice a smell with your nose
example: The kitchen smells of fresh bread.
note_ru: Британские формы smelt; американские — smelled.

def: a deep metal pot with a handle for cooking on the cooker
example: Boil the rice in a big saucepan.
note_ru: Несмотря на название, в saucepan варят не только соус: это обычная кастрюля с ручкой.

def: a thick white food made from milk, often with fruit
example: I have yoghurt and fruit for breakfast.
example_ru: На завтрак я ем йогурт с фруктами.
note_ru: Британское написание yoghurt, американское — yogurt; ударение на первый слог.

def: a flat pan for frying food
example: Put some oil in the frying pan.

def: a plate or bowl for food; food cooked in a special way
example: My favourite dish is fish and chips.
example_ru: Моё любимое блюдо — рыба с картошкой фри.
note_ru: To do the dishes — мыть посуду (амер.); брит. — do the washing-up.

def: a glass container for jam, honey and other food
example: There is a jar of jam on the table.
note_ru: Стеклянная банка — jar, жестяная — tin (брит.) / can.

def: the top that closes a pan, box or jar
example: Put the lid on the pan.

def: to break food into small pieces with your teeth
example: Chew your food slowly.
note_ru: Chewing gum — жевательная резинка.

def: the day each year when you were born
example: My birthday is in May.

def: a thing you give to someone on a special day
example: Thank you for the lovely present!
note_ru: Present и gift — синонимы; present чуть более разговорное.

def: a present
example: This watch was a gift from my parents.
example_ru: Эти часы были подарком от моих родителей.
note_ru: Gift shop — магазин подарков; gift card — подарочная карта.

def: to come and be with people; to become a member
example: Come and join us at the party!
example_ru: Приходи, присоединяйся к нам на вечеринке!
note_ru: Без предлога: join us, а не join to us.

def: to say yes to an invitation or offer
example: She accepted the invitation to the wedding.

def: the person who invites people to a party
example: The host gave every guest a drink.
note_ru: Также глагол: to host a party — устраивать вечеринку.

def: to say hello to someone
example: She greeted every guest with a smile.

def: to touch someone with your lips
example: She kissed her mother and said goodbye.

def: what you say when you drink with friends; also 'thank you' in Britain
example: Cheers! Happy birthday!
note_ru: В Британии cheers в разговорной речи также значит «спасибо» и «пока».

def: to like doing something
example: Did you enjoy the party?
note_ru: После enjoy — существительное или -ing: enjoy dancing. Enjoy yourself! — Повеселись!

def: something funny that you say
example: He told a funny joke and we all laughed.
example_ru: Он рассказал смешной анекдот, и мы все засмеялись.
note_ru: Рассказывать анекдот — tell a joke (не say).

def: something you do not expect
example: We planned a surprise party for Tom.

def: to think about and decide what to do
example: We are planning a party for Saturday.
note_ru: Формы с удвоением n: planned, planning.

def: to plan and make something happen
example: Who is organising the picnic?
note_ru: Британское написание -ise; американское — organize.

def: to make plans for something to happen
example: Let's arrange a time to meet.

def: a party where you cook food outside on a fire
example: We are having a barbecue in the garden on Sunday.
example_ru: В воскресенье мы устраиваем барбекю в саду.
note_ru: Сокращение — BBQ.

def: a meal that you eat outside, for example in a park
example: Let's have a picnic by the lake.

def: a group of people who meet to do something together; a place to dance at night
example: I am in a football club.

def: a place in Britain where people drink and talk with friends
example: Let's meet at the pub after work.
example_ru: Давай встретимся в пабе после работы.
note_ru: Типично британское место; сокращение от public house.

def: to say that you hope someone has something good
example: I wish you a happy birthday!
note_ru: Best wishes — с наилучшими пожеланиями (в конце письма).

def: to say thank you to someone
example: I want to thank you for the present.
example_ru: Я хочу поблагодарить тебя за подарок.
note_ru: Thank somebody for something: thank you for coming.

def: with each other
example: We cooked dinner together.

def: to visit someone at their home
example: Come round for a coffee on Sunday.
forms: come round – came round – come round
note_ru: Британский вариант; американцы говорят come over.

def: a reason you give for not doing something
example: He had a good excuse for being late.
example_ru: У него была хорошая отговорка за опоздание.
note_ru: Существительное произносится ɪkˈskjuːs, глагол (excuse me) — ɪkˈskjuːz.

def: a person who is in a club or group
example: All members of the club came to the party.
example_ru: Все члены клуба пришли на вечеринку.

def: money that people must pay to their country
example: You pay tax on the money you earn.
example_ru: Ты платишь налог с денег, которые зарабатываешь.

def: paper money
example: He paid with a twenty-pound banknote.
example_ru: Он заплатил банкнотой в двадцать фунтов.
note_ru: Часто просто note: a five-pound note. В США — bill.

def: a small flat case for money and cards
example: I left my wallet at home.
note_ru: Wallet — плоский бумажник (обычно мужской); purse — женский кошелёк (брит.).

def: a small bag for money, used by women
example: She took a coin out of her purse.
note_ru: В американском английском purse — женская сумочка.

def: a machine in the street where you get money from your account
example: Is there a cash machine near here?
note_ru: Также ATM (чаще в США) или cashpoint (брит.).

def: the secret number for your bank card
example: Enter your PIN and press the green button.
example_ru: Введите ПИН-код и нажмите зелёную кнопку.
note_ru: Говорят PIN или PIN number; никому не сообщайте свой PIN.

def: a piece of paper from your bank that you write to pay someone
example: Can I pay by cheque?
note_ru: Британское написание; американское — check. Чек из магазина — receipt.

def: the money of a country
example: The currency of Japan is the yen.

def: how much one currency costs in another
example: What is the exchange rate for euros today?

def: to send money from one account to another
example: I transferred the money to your account yesterday.
example_ru: Я перевёл деньги на твой счёт вчера.
note_ru: Ударение в глаголе на второй слог, в существительном transfer — на первый.

def: with a lot of money
example: He is not rich, but he is happy.
example_ru: Он не богат, но он счастлив.

def: with very little money
example: They were too poor to buy a car.
example_ru: Они были слишком бедны, чтобы купить машину.
note_ru: Также «бедный» в смысле «несчастный»: poor thing! — бедняжка!

def: to put money into a bank account
example: I deposited two hundred pounds in my account.
example_ru: Я внёс двести фунтов на свой счёт.
note_ru: Антоним — withdraw (снимать деньги). Существительное deposit — также залог за квартиру.

def: to look at two or more things to see how they are different
example: Compare the prices before you buy.
note_ru: Compare A with / to B.

def: something you win in a competition
example: The first prize is a trip to Rome.
note_ru: Prize — приз за победу; price — цена. Не путайте!

def: a game where you buy a ticket and can win money
example: He won a million pounds in the lottery.
example_ru: Он выиграл миллион фунтов в лотерею.

def: money that parents give to children every week
example: I get ten pounds pocket money a week.
example_ru: Я получаю десять фунтов карманных денег в неделю.
note_ru: В США чаще allowance.

def: money that you keep and do not spend
example: We used our savings to buy a flat.
example_ru: Мы потратили сбережения, чтобы купить квартиру.
note_ru: Всегда во множественном числе; savings account — сберегательный счёт.

def: money you pay for a service, a lesson or to join something
example: There is a fee of two pounds for the card.
example_ru: За карту взимается плата два фунта.
note_ru: School fees — плата за обучение, entrance fee — входная плата.

def: your name, written by you in your own way
example: Please put your signature here.
note_ru: Глагол — to sign (подписывать).

def: one part of a hundred (%)
example: Prices went up by ten per cent.
note_ru: Британское написание — раздельно per cent; американское — percent.

def: costing half of the usual price
example: These shoes are half price today.

def: paying by card without putting it into the machine
example: You can pay contactless on the bus.

def: to pay with a bank card, not cash
example: Can I pay by card?
note_ru: Запомните предлог: pay by card, но pay in cash.

def: the smallest British coin; 100 pence = 1 pound
example: The sweets cost fifty pence.
note_ru: Множественное число для суммы — pence (сокращённо p), для монет — pennies.

def: the system that connects computers all over the world
example: I found this recipe on the internet.
example_ru: Я нашёл этот рецепт в интернете.
note_ru: С артиклем: on the internet.

def: words that you send to someone
example: I sent her a message, but she didn't reply.
example_ru: Я отправил ей сообщение, но она не ответила.

def: a small flat computer with a touch screen
example: My son plays games on his tablet.
example_ru: Мой сын играет в игры на планшете.
note_ru: Также «таблетка»: take two tablets a day.

def: a phone that can connect to the internet
example: Everyone has a smartphone these days.

def: a long wire that connects devices
example: I need a cable to connect the printer.
example_ru: Мне нужен кабель, чтобы подключить принтер.

def: to start a machine or light
example: Switch on the computer and wait.
note_ru: Синоним — turn on.

def: to stop a machine or light
example: Please switch off your phones.

def: to write with a keyboard
example: Type your name and press Enter.
example_ru: Напечатай своё имя и нажми Enter.
note_ru: Печатать на принтере — print, а на клавиатуре — type.

def: to make the same thing again
example: Copy the text and send it to me.

def: to put copied text or pictures into a document
example: Copy the link and paste it here.
example_ru: Скопируй ссылку и вставь её сюда.
note_ru: Copy and paste — скопировать и вставить.

def: to join one thing to another; to join the internet
example: I can't connect to the wi-fi.
example_ru: Я не могу подключиться к вай-фаю.

def: the link between a device and the internet
example: The internet connection is very slow here.

def: not connected to the internet
example: You can read this book offline.

def: to create an account on a website or app
example: Sign up and get a free month.
note_ru: Sign up for something: sign up for a course.

def: to leave your account on a computer or website
example: Don't forget to log out.
note_ru: Антоним — log in; также говорят log off.

def: to put a message or photo on the internet
example: She posted the photos from the party.
note_ru: Также «отправлять по почте» (брит.): post a letter.

def: something you write under a post
example: There are fifty comments under his video.

def: a photo that you take of yourself
example: We took a selfie on the beach.

def: a place on a computer where you keep files
example: Save the photos in a new folder.

def: a file with text; an important paper
example: Open the document and read the first page.
example_ru: Открой документ и прочитай первую страницу.

def: a small picture on a screen that you click
example: Click the icon to open the app.
example_ru: Нажми на иконку, чтобы открыть приложение.

def: the part of a device where you change how it works
example: Go to settings and change the language.
example_ru: Зайди в настройки и поменяй язык.

def: a message from an app that something has happened
example: I get too many notifications from this app.
example_ru: Я получаю слишком много уведомлений от этого приложения.

def: a phone call where you can see the other person
example: We had a video call with my grandparents.
example_ru: У нас был видеозвонок с бабушкой и дедушкой.

def: a bad program that can break your computer
example: My laptop has a virus and is very slow.
example_ru: У моего ноутбука вирус, и он очень медленный.

def: to lift something up; to make something higher
example: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
note_ru: Raise — поднимать что-то (с объектом); rise — подниматься (без объекта).

def: to move your foot and put it down in a new place
example: Be careful, don't step on the glass.
note_ru: Также существительное: a step — шаг, ступенька.

def: to jump into water with your head first
example: He dived into the cold lake.
note_ru: В американском английском прошедшее время часто dove.

def: to move backwards and forwards through the air
example: The children are swinging in the park.
example_ru: Дети качаются на качелях в парке.
note_ru: Качели — a swing.

def: to change and become something different
example: The rain turned into snow in the evening.

def: to become smaller, for example after washing
example: My jumper shrank in the washing machine.
example_ru: Мой свитер сел в стиральной машине.

def: to go up
example: The sun rises at six in summer.
note_ru: Rise — подниматься (самому); raise — поднимать что-то.

def: to start to be something
example: It is becoming cold outside.

def: to become bigger in number or amount
example: Prices increased again last month.
example_ru: В прошлом месяце цены снова выросли.
note_ru: Ударение в глаголе на второй слог (inˈcrease), в существительном — на первый (ˈincrease). Антоним — decrease.

def: to grow and become bigger or better
example: The small village developed into a big town.
example_ru: Маленькая деревня развилась в большой город.

def: to be flat on a bed, floor or the ground
example: The cat lies on the sofa all day.
example_ru: Кот лежит на диване весь день.
note_ru: Lie (лежать): lie – lay – lain; lie (врать): lie – lied – lied; lay (класть): lay – laid – laid.

def: to move the top part of your body down; to make something curved
example: Bend down and pick up the book.

def: to move your body towards something; to rest against something
example: Don't lean on the door, it is not safe.
example_ru: Не прислоняйся к двери, это небезопасно.
note_ru: Британские формы leant (произносится lent); американские — leaned.

def: to fall or almost fall on wet or icy ground
example: I slipped on the ice and hurt my leg.
example_ru: Я поскользнулся на льду и ушиб ногу.

def: to move by turning over and over
example: The ball rolled under the car.

def: to move smoothly over a surface
example: The children slid down the hill on the snow.
example_ru: Дети съехали с горки по снегу.

def: to move on your hands and knees
example: The baby is crawling on the floor.

def: to run after someone or something
example: The dog chased the cat up the tree.

def: to get away from a place or a dangerous situation
example: The dog escaped from the garden.
note_ru: Escape from a place — с предлогом from.

def: to go somewhere very fast
example: We rushed to the station but missed the train.
example_ru: Мы помчались на вокзал, но опоздали на поезд.
note_ru: Rush hour — час пик.

def: to arrive at a place; to touch something with your hand
example: We reached the hotel at midnight.
example_ru: Мы добрались до гостиницы в полночь.
note_ru: Без предлога: reach the city, а не reach to the city.

def: to go into a place
example: Please knock before you enter the room.
example_ru: Пожалуйста, стучите, прежде чем войти в комнату.
note_ru: Без предлога: enter the room. В разговорной речи чаще go in / come in.

def: to start to be seen
example: A rainbow appeared in the sky.

def: to stop being seen
example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.

def: to show something with your finger
example: She pointed at the big house.
note_ru: Point at / to something; показывать пальцем на людей считается невежливым.

def: very unhappy because something bad happened
example: Mum was angry because I came home late.
example_ru: Мама рассердилась, потому что я пришёл домой поздно.
note_ru: Angry with somebody, angry about something.

def: wanting to drink
example: I am thirsty. Can I have some water?
example_ru: Я хочу пить. Можно мне воды?
note_ru: «Я хочу пить» — I'm thirsty (не I want to drink).

def: tired and wanting to sleep
example: The baby is sleepy, put her to bed.

def: afraid
example: The little boy was frightened of the dog.
note_ru: Frightened of something; frightening — страшный, пугающий.

def: nice and friendly to other people
example: It was very kind of you to help me.
example_ru: Было очень любезно с твоей стороны помочь мне.
note_ru: Также существительное «вид, тип»: what kind of music?

def: making you laugh
example: This film is really funny.
note_ru: Funny — смешной; fun — весёлый, приятный: the party was fun.

def: not interesting
example: The lesson was long and boring.
note_ru: Boring — скучный (о предмете); bored — скучающий (о человеке): I'm bored.

def: making you feel happy and interested
example: The match was very exciting.
note_ru: Exciting — о событии; excited — о человеке.

def: having good things happen to you
example: You are lucky to have such good friends.
example_ru: Тебе повезло, что у тебя такие хорошие друзья.
note_ru: «Мне повезло» — I'm lucky (не I'm happy).

def: known by many people
example: London is famous for its red buses.
note_ru: Famous for something.

def: with a big effect; that you must think about
example: It is important to drink a lot of water.

def: not the same
example: My sister and I like different music.
example_ru: Мы с сестрой любим разную музыку.
note_ru: Different from (брит.) / different than (амер.).

def: with little noise
example: The village is very quiet at night.
note_ru: Не путайте с quite (довольно).

def: making a lot of noise
example: The music is too loud, turn it down.

def: making a lot of noise
example: Our neighbours are very noisy.

def: that can hurt you
example: It is dangerous to swim here.

def: not dangerous
example: Is the water safe to drink?
note_ru: Safe and sound — в целости и сохранности.

def: not clean
example: Wash your hands, they are dirty.

def: with nothing inside
example: The fridge is empty, let's go shopping.

def: with no more space inside
example: The bus was full, so we walked.
example_ru: Автобус был полным, поэтому мы пошли пешком.
note_ru: I'm full — я сыт (после еды).

def: weighing a lot; difficult to carry
example: This suitcase is too heavy for me.
example_ru: Этот чемодан слишком тяжёлый для меня.
note_ru: Heavy rain — сильный дождь, heavy traffic — плотное движение.

def: not hard; nice to touch
example: The bed is very soft.

def: with little or no light
example: It gets dark early in winter.

def: that helps you
example: A dictionary is very useful for learning words.
example_ru: Словарь очень полезен для изучения слов.
note_ru: Антоним — useless (бесполезный).

def: not correct
example: Sorry, I think you have the wrong number.
note_ru: What's wrong? — Что случилось? Антоним — right.
